'''A7-M1''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lana Beniko]] as a messenger on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconsituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Cartel" />
